bongo-rx-four-size-starter-kit.name: Bongo Rx Four-Size Starter Kit
bongo-rx-four-size-starter-kit.description: Bongo Rx – Four Sizes Starter Kit (BNG500). Includes 1 each of sizes SM, MD, LG and XL, a headgear, a travel case and a drying stand. AirAvant recommends that every patient start with this kit, so the size that fits best can be found at home.
features: No machine or power required — small and simple
Uses the patient's own exhalation to generate EPAP (Expiratory Positive Airway Pressure)
Soft nasal seals; small valves open on inhalation and close on exhalation, directing exhaled air through precisely designed vent holes
Use at home and while traveling
Simple to use: quick startup, no assembly required, easy to clean
Manufacturer statement: clinically tested and FDA-cleared for mild to moderate obstructive sleep apnea
Prescription device — AirAvant: all devices that treat sleep apnea require a prescription in the U.S.
Designed and made in the USA

bongo-rx-annual-replenishment-pack.name: Bongo Rx Annual Replenishment Pack
bongo-rx-annual-replenishment-pack.description: Bongo Rx – Annual Replenishment Pack. Each pack includes 4 Bongo Rx devices of a single size, a headgear, a travel case and a drying stand. Choose the size (XS, SM, MD, LG or XL); each size is its own AirAvant part number (BNG501–BNG505). AirAvant: once a patient knows their preferred size and has used the Starter Kit for up to 90 days, order the Annual Replenishment Pack in that size. Sizes can be mixed and matched for quantity pricing. XS is offered in replenishment packs and single units only — the Starter Kit holds SM, MD, LG and XL.
features: No machine or power required — small and simple
Uses the patient's own exhalation to generate EPAP (Expiratory Positive Airway Pressure)
Soft nasal seals; small valves open on inhalation and close on exhalation, directing exhaled air through precisely designed vent holes
Use at home and while traveling
Simple to use: quick startup, no assembly required, easy to clean
Manufacturer statement: clinically tested and FDA-cleared for mild to moderate obstructive sleep apnea
Prescription device — AirAvant: all devices that treat sleep apnea require a prescription in the U.S.
Designed and made in the USA
